title: The Cosmos is Finite
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 24.11 Linked Discourses 24.11
  • 1. Sotāpattivagga 1. Stream-Entry

Antavāsutta The Cosmos is Finite

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Kismiṁ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṁ upādāya, kiṁ abhinivissa evaṁ diṭṭhi uppajjati: “Mendicants, when what exists, because of grasping what and insisting on what, does the view arise: ‘antavā loko’”ti? ‘The cosmos is finite’?” …

“Bhagavaṁmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā …pe… niyato sambodhiparāyano”ti.

Ekādasamaṁ.
